method: Isolated layer, one traced replay per cell, CP8/TP4, four 256K cache slots initialized with random values. Embedding, RoPE preparation and host staging are outside the timed layer. Both paths use reduce-scatter. Bars sum device-kernel times: tt-perf-report 1.4.0 uses the maximum across devices for ordinary ops and the average for collectives. These are profiled per-layer measurements, not 60-layer model latency.

provenance.note: The existing two-trace isolated-layer harness ran with allocation tracking disabled; no model kernels changed.
